abstract: An infant diagnosed with sacrococcygeal teratoma was referred to the authors' hospital. On day 5 of admission, the infant underwent complete surgical resection of the tumor. Unfortunately, the wound was infected by Enterobacter cloacae and dehisced. Advanced dressings combined with vacuum sealing drainage were applied to facilitate wound healing. Eighteen days postsurgery, the wound showed good epithelialization, and the patient was discharged. The patient received regular dressing changes at a local hospital, and follow-up was conducted through telephone for 3 months. After 3 months, scar tissue formation was observed, and no complications were reported.
abstract_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫と診断された乳児が、当院に紹介された。入院5日目に、腫瘍の完全な外科的切除を受けた。残念ながら、創部はEnterobacter cloacaeに感染し、離開した。創傷治癒を促すため、先進的ドレッシング材と陰圧閉鎖療法を併用した。術後18日目には創部の良好な上皮化が認められ、退院となった。患者は地元の病院で定期的な創部のドレッシング交換を受け、3か月間にわたり電話による経過観察を行った。3か月後には瘢痕組織の形成が認められたが、合併症の報告はなかった。
